title: Zesty Roasted Egyptian Fish Kebabs
description: A light and flavorful Egyptian dish featuring roasted fish, yellow pepper, and a blend of spices, perfect for a sick day or a weeknight dinner. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tandoor spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the fish, yellow pepper, onion, and garlic to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the fish and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 12 minutes.
Flip the skewers over and continue to roast for an additional 8 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
